description: What a host is, as its hello says (and sessions carries).

models.description: Every model it can run: {value, displayName}, a Codex model's as its catalogue has it.

checkout.description: Where its code is (a head here run from elsewhere is told so).

init.description: What a session's program last said to initialize, with every model it can run in it.

commit.description: The git commit its code was as it started (null: not a checkout).

update.description: Its own updater's newer version, if it has one ready.

mesh.description: The members it reaches and the links it's made.

notes.description: Record's notebooks here, as written last (notes.stamp: "" for none).

ops.description: Given by a host that speaks only part of these lines (a phone's): the ops it takes, and what its sessions take that came with a version or a program (start's ephemeral; control requests: control, set_permission_mode, set_model), which a head checks (speaks) instead of its version.
